# `network/invites/InvitePacket.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/invites/InvitePacket.js`

network/invites/InvitePacket.js — signed, one-time, expiring invites (network plan §13).  An invite is a doorway into a group's approval process, NOT automatic membership: it just names a temporary meeting route and a role offer, and is signed by the inviter so anyone can verify who issued it. It does not itself grant route/group access — that capability is minted only after the join-request identity exchange (see JoinFlow.js), once the joiner's real principal is known. "Base64 is not security" (network plan §13) — the encode/decode here is just a convenient transport, the actual guarantee is the ECDSA signature over the canonical envelope (protocol.js).
